label: prop:q-gl-obstruction-calc
title: Obstruction to $q$-flatness
html:
Proposition. Obstruction to q-flatness

Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with \chi(A) \neq 0 and obstruction class \kappa_0 = e(\xi) \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m) (quantum characteristic classes).

  1. The intrinsic q-curvature of a q-flat connection \nabla_q on a G_q-bundle over X is 
      \mathcal{F}_q^{\mathrm{intr}}
  = 
  \mathrm{HKR}^{-1}(\kappa_0)
   \in 
  HH^2(\mathcal{U}_q, \mathrm{Ad}).
    This curvature is non-zero whenever \kappa_0 \neq 0. The non-vanishing of d_q^2 forces q-flat connections to carry intrinsic curvature.
  2. A q-connection \nabla_q is q-flat (q-flat connection) when its connection-dependent curvature \mathcal{F}_q^{\mathrm{conn}} vanishes. Lifting q-flat connections through the brane tower requires \kappa_0 \equiv 0 \pmod n at the target level.
  3. At Kummer level n, the obstruction \kappa_0 \bmod n vanishes if and only if n \mid \chi(A). Thus, q-flat G_q-connections lift to level n only when n divides |\chi(A)|.
  4. For \chi(A) \neq 0, the condition \kappa_0 \not\equiv 0 \pmod n holds at a density-1 set of Kummer levels n \in \mathbb{Z}_{>0}; this is the perpetual obstruction. The q-local systems exist as objects with intrinsic curvature, but their brane tower lifts are obstructed at cofinitely many levels.
